run: set -eux; for dir in /usr/local/bin /opt/conda/bin /opt/homebrew/bin; do mkdir -p "$dir"; ln -sf /usr/bin/python3 "$dir/python"; ln -sf /usr/bin/python3 "$dir/python3"; ln -sf /usr/bin/pip3 "$dir/pip"; ln -sf /usr/bin/pip3 "$dir/pip3"; done; python --version; /usr/local/bin/python --version; /opt/conda/bin/python --version; /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 --version; pip3 --version

set -eux; node_arch="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; case "$node_arch" in amd64) node_arch="x64" ;; arm64) node_arch="arm64" ;; armhf) node_arch="armv7l" ;; ppc64el) node_arch="ppc64le" ;; s390x) node_arch="s390x" ;; *) echo "unsupported Node.js architecture: $(dpkg --print-architecture)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; node_dist_base="https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v22.x"; mkdir -p /tmp/node-install; curl -fsSL "$node_dist_base/SHASUMS256.txt" -o /tmp/node-install/SHASUMS256.txt; node_file="$(awk -v suffix="-linux-${node_arch}.tar.xz" 'index($2, "node-v") == 1 && substr($2, length($2) - length(suffix) + 1) == suffix { print $2; exit }' /tmp/node-install/SHASUMS256.txt)"; test -n "$node_file"; curl -fsSL "$node_dist_base/$node_file" -o "/tmp/node-install/$node_file"; awk -v file="$node_file" '$2 == file { print }' /tmp/node-install/SHASUMS256.txt > /tmp/node-install/SHASUMS256.selected; (cd /tmp/node-install && sha256sum -c SHASUMS256.selected); tar -xJf "/tmp/node-install/$node_file" -C /usr/local --strip-components=1; rm -rf /tmp/node-install; node --version; npm --version

set -eux; npm install -g playwright@1.61.0 @playwright/test@1.61.0; PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/ms-playwright playwright install --with-deps chromium; chmod -R a+rX /ms-playwright /usr/local/lib/node_modules; for sandbox in /ms-playwright/chromium-*/chrome-linux*/chrome_sandbox; do chown root:root "$sandbox"; chmod 4755 "$sandbox"; ln -s chrome_sandbox "${sandbox%/*}/chrome-sandbox"; done; playwright --version

getent group docker || groupadd docker; id -u agents-in-the-cloud >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash agents-in-the-cloud; echo 'agents-in-the-cloud ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/agents-in-the-cloud; chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/agents-in-the-cloud; install -d -o agents-in-the-cloud -g agents-in-the-cloud /.agents-in-the-cloud /work; usermod -aG docker agents-in-the-cloud
systemctl mask tmp.mount getty@tty1.service console-getty.service; ln -sf /lib/systemd/system/multi-user.target /etc/systemd/system/default.target
